title: Booking Calls
seo: Booking calls and demos from chat
meta: An assistant that offers times and books calls or demos straight into your calendar. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Booking calls and demos straight from chat
overview: When a shopper or business buyer is ready to talk, the chat should help them book, not send them to a contact form. We connect your assistant to your calendar tool so it offers real free times and confirms the booking by email. We set meeting types, buffer times and questions to ask before the call. Then we test bookings across time zones and make sure reminders and reschedule links work.

faq: Google Calendar, Outlook and booking tools such as Calendly or Cal.com. We check what your tool allows and use its own booking page where it is the safest option.
Can the assistant book without a person?
Yes. It offers times, you control which, and the booking appears in your calendar. You can also require a short question or approval before a call is confirmed.
Yes. Times show in the visitor's time zone and are tested across several. We also check daylight saving changes, so a call is never an hour out.
Does it work for service businesses too?
Yes. It suits quotes, consults and demos as well as shop calls. If you take payment before a booking, tell us, and we check what your booking tool supports.
